parsed.internal_thinking: Jimmy used a Monopoly card on Brick (טיט). He specifically targeted me and Claude after we both refused to trade it to him. This is a aggressive move, but he did warn me earlier. My hand is now empty of Brick, which I just bank-traded for. This sets me back significantly on my path to node 34. Jimmy is definitely not the 'neutral' party he claimed to be.
